body:
Part 2 of my other map, DarkTrot. 

This will have no spawners but will focus mainly on you guys blowing up the crap put of each other. 

I unfortunately have no pics but i will post some up soon as i complete this topic. I pruned the world before making screenies. How foolish is that? lel

Anyway, I hope you guys will enjoy this. 

Features:

  • 40vs40
  • TNT
  • Enchanting
  • No villagers (Curse you, stupid limited plugin! *Glares*)

replies.author: Awarrior
replies.body:
Positive Feedback: Interesting trees and and not symmetrical build which is considerably harder to build and requires more time.

Constructive Feedback: The terrain is way random and too many different blocks were used in no particular order or design, they dont really match aswell...   It is ok to use many blocks as long as they are used in a "group" and have a purpose together. 


Exemple: I know this is really cheap, but im gonna use one of my own builds to show you what I mean by "group"

The clay used in the mountains add the "rocky" feeling/aspect to them, and dont get me wrong, they have been randomized too!


But keep up the good work!
